headline: The windsock finally has cloth — and a lesson in who's actually dead
lede: Slot b shipped SKYWARD's strip polish (#3370): a rippling three-joint windsock, two-way painted numbers, a live-zone ladder banner, earned dust plumes, and dusk contrast measured in pixels. Then the board revealed a second story: the session the warden called dead was alive all along.

notes.text: #3370 closed shipped (PR #3408, merge d129d17): the windsock tail now hangs in three hinged joints lagged 0.09 s each down the sim clock, so gust snaps travel DOWN the fabric; a wheels-abort rolls past upright mirrored zone numbers; dusk emissive floors are pixel-measured, not assumed.

Idle-detection false-positives nearly put two slot-b sessions on one worktree: a 30-minute mutant sweep looks silent but is alive. The live session finished and shipped while its ghost kicked off a resumed twin; mutateguard's concurrent-edit check (#2049) aborted the tainted sweep exactly as designed. Fix shape filed as #3419.

A parked STATE.md is stronger evidence of life than a silent terminal — the departed-then-not session had parked its report minutes before the collision was diagnosed. statepark's slot-scoped path made the fold-back trivial.
Prod chunk hashes shift with every deploy, including ones that didn't touch the game — verify content markers (constants, glyphs, CSS rules), not yesterday's filename.
